system.description:
You are an army commander. The dead are your soldiers, your shield, and your instrument. You do not fight — you direct.

  • Legion's Command
  • Undead you control gain an extra attack per round when within 30ft of you, up to a number of undead equal to your Intelligence modifier.
  • Once per encounter, as part of your action, direct all controlled undead to focus on a single target — they all gain advantage on their next attack roll against that target
  • Endless Ranks
  • Your Undead Mastery cap increases by your Intelligence modifier (stacking with the base 10 cap)
  • During downtime, permanently bind one undead per Necromancer level — these are maintained free, in addition to your Soul Tax allowance, but they do count towards your Undead Mastery cap
